description:
An easy-to-use Windows manager for personal game servers.

Synix Control Panel installs, configures, updates, monitors, and backs up personal game servers from one Windows application.
v1.0.25 expands Minecraft server management with configuration and file editing, world and modpack tools, compatibility checks, and change recovery. Mod and plugin imports now offer ZIP and folder selection, recognized-package detection, installation previews, activation guidance, and rollback. Added ARK: Survival Evolved and Survival Ascended package handling, Empyrion add-on support, and game-specific mod setup guidance.

Added YAML configuration editing, world-seed generation, and updated Empyrion, Foundry, and Dysterra configuration templates. Shared configuration values now synchronize with Synix’s saved server settings after edits and restores. Server setup now displays the Review step before enabling Save.

Improved backup retention, interrupted-restore recovery, and startup safety. Failed requested backups or updates prevent startup, and failed settings synchronization preserves recovery files. Fixed Minecraft console line wrapping, clipped details, inconsistent styling, and leftover add-on data after server deletion. Improved help content, sensitive-data redaction, file-path safeguards, and regression tests.

Mod installation and activation depend on the game, loader, and package format.
